snippet.title: Witch College DEMO trailer
snippet.description:
Do you believe in magic?

The Halloween Dance is coming soon, and you don’t have a partner! Meanwhile, a new girl just arrived to school and she seems like the perfect candidate!

However, strange things are occurring and they may be the work of an ancient powerful sorcerer: The Sunflower Witch. 

Who is behind the magic? Are witches even real? And more importantly, who are you gonna take to the dance!?

Play Witch College now!
https://store.steampowered.com/app/1116020/Witch_College/
